newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Flour mills seeking wheat.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Flour mills seeking wheat.

text.p: Flour mills were the best bidders for hard red winter wheat in many areas as tight supplies forced aggressive bidding, grain dealers said.
Topeka, Kan., mills were bidding 58 cents over KCBT July versus exporter bids of 55 over at the Texas Gulf. Kansas dealers said exporters normally outbid the mills.
"Right now it's a processors' market. Stocks are getting low and they have to bid for it," said a Kansas dealer.
New-crop sales also were light in Kansas because freeze damage and dry conditions still had farmers unsure about the size of this year's crop, dealers said.
"They just don't know if they will have a crop until it rains," said a northwest Kansas dealer.
A slight chance for rain was forecast for northwest Kansas late Wednedsay, but a 50 percent chance was forecast Friday, dealers said.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: N=KCBT July. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
